text_blocks.snippet: You can browse active listings and check current prices for the Charizard V on TCGplayer.

list.snippet: Darkness Ablaze (#019/189): The first Charizard V ever printed, featuring 220 HP, Claw Slash (80 damage), and Fire Spin (220 damage, discards 2 energy). Typically values around $8 to $11 for a raw near-mint copy.
Brilliant Stars (#017/172): An Ultra Rare Basic Pokémon featuring Incinerate (90 damage, discards opponent tools) and Heat Blast (180 damage). Valued around $3 to $10.
Brilliant Stars Alternate Full Art (#154/172): Features a dramatic battle scene against Venusaur and commands higher collector values.
Champion's Path Promo (SWSH050): A Black Star Promo reprint of the Darkness Ablaze artwork, commonly valued around $8 to $13.
Champion's Path Secret Rare / Shiny (#079): Features a shiny Charizard version that can command hundreds of dollars depending on its condition and grading (such as PSA 10).
V Rule: When your Pokémon V is knocked out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
Stage & Type: Basic Fire-type Pokémon with standard 220 HP across most standard prints.
